name: Mailpit
description: Email & SMTP testing tool with API for developers
composeYaml:
services:
  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:latest
    ports:
      - '1025:1025'
    volumes:
      - 'mailpit-data:/data'
      -
        type: bind
        source: ./htpasswd
        target: /data/htpasswd
        isDirectory: false
        content: ''
    environment:
      - MP_MAX_MESSAGES=5000
      - MP_DATABASE=/data/mailpit.db
      - MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY=1
      - MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE=1
      - MP_UI_AUTH_FILE=/data/htpasswd
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /mailpit
        - readyz
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
